newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's BCB debuts at 4.90 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's BCB debuts at 4.90 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian property and infrastructure firm BCB Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board on Tuesday at 4.90 ringgit, against an offer price of 1.80 ringgit.
At 0135 GMT, the stock was trading at 4.40 ringgit. The company had made a public issue of 15 million shares.
For the year ended June 30, 1996, the company posted a pre-tax profit of 36.40 million ringgit and net profit of 25.01 million ringgit or 59.56 cents a share. Turnover was 112.31 million ringgit.
BCB has forecast pre-tax profit of 51.20 million ringgit, net earnings of 36.33 million ringgit and net earnings per share of 33.82 cents for the year ending June 30, 1997.
Besides projects in Malaysia, BCB has said it wants to invest in property markets overseas including South Africa and the Philippines.
